cohort: The study included 254 pregnant women diagnosed with placenta praevia reporting to the Outpatient Department and Emergency Department at Combined Military Hospital Lahore.
finding: Multiparous women and those with a history of previous caesarean section carry a higher risk for placenta praevia.
mod_finding: Women with a history of previous caesarean section have a higher risk for placenta praevia.
gest_age: Majority of patients (57.08%) presented at <=37 weeks gestation.
